title: Chapter 767
paragraphs: Chapter 767
Episode 189. The Fortune That Rolls In (1)
August 20, 1803.
About a month had passed since Leuth returned with her people.
As soon as she started her job as the housekeeper, she quickly took control of the clan and proved her abilities.

"[10th Flagbearer, I think it would be good to strengthen the support for the neutral polluted areas. Since Zipple is becoming increasingly passive in supporting the neutral polluted areas, we should step in and capture them.]"

"Madam Housekeeper, the areas where Zipple is passively supporting are mostly places where there's nothing to gain. Rather, the reconstruction cost will be higher if we try to affiliate them with the Huphester Alliance after relief."

"[I know, they're areas with no useful resources and mostly those that have collapsed from the foundation. But what's important now is the status of Runcandel. On a humanitarian level, we can save that many lives by reducing our sleep.]"
"I understand."

"[Moreover, talent is the most important thing at this time, and we never know where talent will suddenly appear. A person who is necessary for us may suddenly appear from the area where the clan provided relief. Didn't engineers come from the area that the 7th Flagbearer provided relief before? There were many cases like that in my time.]"
Leuth is not just a housekeeper, but the ancestor who left the current Runcandel.
Even the former heads of the family, who were the oldest adults in the family before she came, are her distant descendants.
Moreover, after seeing Leuth's work ability, Jin gave her the authority to wield full power in internal affairs, so she was now the de facto second in command of Runcandel.
"[Chief Instructor of the trainees, Tasha.]"
"[Speak, Madam Housekeeper.]"
"[The new trainees we got this time are all excellent. After the election of the team leader is over, distribute a famous sword to each of them.]"
"[I already have a few swords set aside.]"

"[Also, pay special attention to those among the new trainees who had trouble in their previous activities. To prevent unnecessary factional divisions. It's good to stimulate the fighting spirit through competition, but it's not a method that suits the current situation. Always set a goal that requires fighting and winning together.]"
"[I will do so.]"
"[Balas, how is the Black Sword Association these days?]"
"[Ha-ha, I can't get the blood off my sword, I'm so busy killing those guys who claim reconstruction costs. They're all punks.]"

"[Very good. The Black Sword Association must continue to show that it will severely punish even the smallest corruption in Huphester. However, there should not be a single person who is treated unfairly.]"

"[Don't worry, for those who seem truly ambiguous, we take them to the Princess of Tikan to confirm the truth. However, I think we will definitely need to increase our power. So, it would be great if the Chief Instructor could send over anyone who shows potential.]"
"[The Law Society is currently focusing on compiling the clan's legal code. From what I read, chapter 5 is generally too strict. How about easing the etiquette standards a little?]"
"[Madam Housekeeper, I believe it is right not to compromise on that part. No matter how chaotic the times are, the legal code must be followed.]"
"[You have a point.]"
"[Instead, I will add provisions that can be applied flexibly depending on exceptional situations.]"
"[That's an excellent alternative, please proceed. And Chairman of the Civil Society, Telrot.]"
"Yes, Madam Housekeeper."

"[Traveling around encouraging both the original residents and immigrants, and preemptively preventing various disputes, is very good. It's also part of your duty as Chairman. However, I think it would be better to focus more on directly inspecting the talents among the relief citizens.]"
"I understand, Madam Housekeeper."
"[First rank housekeeper, Petro.]"
"Yes! Madam Housekeeper."

"[There is a need for the clan's financial reports to be better organized. Make an effort to ensure that each department cooperates more closely and shares information. You are the first rank housekeeper and the dedicated housekeeper of the small clan, you should do that. And there was a missing item about the profits from the sale in the Ruterro Alliance's black market. This kind of mistake can't be tolerated twice.]"
"I apologize, I will correct it immediately."
"[It seems we have roughly organized everything. Let's all go back to our places and work. The next meeting will be held at two in the morning.]"
The members of Runcandel were living days that were like a march of hardship.
However, there was no one who harbored any complaints.
Leuth had a strange power to relentlessly drive her relatives while simultaneously infusing them with constant vitality.
Everyone left to carry out Leuth's orders, and two hours later, Jin came to the conference room.
Leuth got up from her seat and greeted him with respect.
"Housekeeper."
"[Did you come, clan head?]"
"I heard you haven't been sleeping for days. Are you okay?"
"[This much is not a big deal for a fairy. Thanks to the clan head who has set a good overall framework, I'm working very smoothly. I smell earth and iron, have you been to the empire?]"
“Yes, I've been looking at the construction site of the dry dock. The foundation work for digging underground has already ended, and we've started the interior work."
"[There must be a shortage of engineers. Even in my time, high-difficulty construction engineers were very valuable.]"

“It seems so. However, even though we are somehow filling up the engineers, the lack of a general construction manager and engineers to build the fleet after the dry dock is completed is more of a problem."
Just drilling the underground of Geomhwangji alone requires tremendous technology.
However, that part was solved in a short period of time through the power of the high-ranking warriors, various magic, and the authority of the spirits.
Literally, they dug the ground with power and prevented the collapse with the power of spirits and magic.
However, the real interior work could not be carried out in that way.
The world's top-level construction engineers were needed to realize Qwaul's blueprint.
Qwaul is temporarily in charge of the overall responsibility, but his main job is magical engineering.
Even if he's a genius centuries ahead, the field of architectural technology was a different matter.
Even the empire's top engineers were having a hard time realizing Qwaul's blueprint.
"According to Dr. Qwaul, at least the top engineers of Zipple or Bubar's technology are needed to work perfectly. Or if a contractor of the god of architecture appears."

"[Although we emphasize that we need to continue to capture talent, it's unknown how much time it will take. And if such a level of genius is needed... In reality, we can only rely on the sky. If we can't get the engineer, it's not impossible to complete, right?]"
“Yes, it's said to be possible. It just takes a few times more time and resources."
"[A few times, we don't have much leeway in finances already. Wait, did you say a contractor of the god of architecture?]"
"Do you have something in mind?"
"[I need to check when and where the last contractor of the god of architecture appeared.]"
Leuth called the scribes and gathered history books about the contractor kept in the clan.

"[Let's see... Here it is, Clap Modal of the Bacul Autonomous Region of the Ruterro Magic Federation made the last contract in March 1666. He died in 1701. The previous contractor was Kien Salasa of the Bacul Autonomous Region in 1603, and before that was Hariet Bayer in 1541, also from the Bacul Autonomous Region.]"
"......They're all from the Bacul Autonomous Region?"

"[The old name of the Bacul Autonomous Region was the Kingdom of Bacul. In my time, it was known as a kingdom particularly loved by the god of architecture. Ah, I remember now. We also sent knights to get the contractor of the god of architecture from the Kingdom of Bacul.]"
"If the god of architecture is still only contracting with those from the Bacul Autonomous Region, there is a high chance that they are already affiliated with Zipple."

"Maybe so. But even if there is a contract holder in the Bacul Autonomous District, it wouldn't hurt to give it a try, right? We can't go in and snatch them up like we did a thousand years ago. It would be nice if we could use the compass to check for the existence of a contract holder in Bacul, gather information through the Seven-Color Bird, and then send Nameless to bring them here."
It's a risky strategy that could potentially lead to a big fight.
But as Leuth said, there was a need to check for the existence of a contract holder through the compass first.
Jin immediately rode the Red Owl to Tikan, grabbed the compass, and returned.
The compass simply shows a red dot in the area where a contract holder exists.
It doesn't even precisely reveal the location, nor does it provide any other information.
The compass showed that there was a red dot in the Bacul Autonomous District, but it wasn't just one.
"……It seems there are more than five contract holders just in Bacul."
Bacul, being close to Drakka and an autonomous district, is an area where Zifle's contracted magicians must frequently visit.
"For the time being, I'll look at the red dots in the Bacul Autonomous District while I work. Observing the fluctuating numbers……."
Just as Leuth finished speaking, someone new came to the meeting room.
"Head Butler, and Sage."
"Knight Telrot."
[What's the matter, Knight Telrot?]
Chairman of the common people, Telrot, made an awkward cough and showed a slightly embarrassed expression.

"There's a boy among the refugees who claims he's a contract holder of the God of Architecture. I came to tell you because I thought it would be necessary to have the help of Princess Tikan or the Head Butler. I told him to show his power, but it seems like he's only babbling nonsense."
Jin and Leuth blinked at each other for a few seconds.
[……What was he saying?]
"He said he's a preliminary contract holder and he needs some kind of trial to make a proper contract. Anyway, he's in the hallway."
Normally, Telrot would have dismissed the boy's words as nonsense, but knowing how desperate they were for a contract holder of the God of Architecture, he came to the meeting room first.
[Let's meet him first, so tell him to come in.]
When Telrot gave the order, the waiting knights brought the boy into the meeting room.
The boy looked like a typical refugee, scrawny and ragged, his eyes harboring the typical wildness of a mischievous boy.
He had been bold in front of Telrot the entire time.
"Ah, I really am a preliminary contract holder of the God of Architecture! You shouldn't be so harsh to me... Huh! Jin Knight! You're really Jin Runcandel, right!?"
And the boy, upon seeing Jin, quickly changed his angry face and his eyes sparkled.
His eyes gleamed as if he had finally met his idol.
Jin took a moment to think about where he had seen that expression before.
It was when he first met Enya.
